title: Commodities 1H Breakout Retest — Entry Valid

rules.breakout_condition: BUY: close > EMA9 > VWAP and > Daily EMA9 | SELL: close < EMA9 < VWAP and < Daily EMA9
rules.daily_ema_filter: daily close must align with trade side vs Daily EMA9
rules.entry_trigger: retest touch + side-confirm candle (green above EMA9/VWAP for BUY, red below EMA9/VWAP for SELL)

notes: 1H breakout-retest strategy applied to this page universe.
Entry allowed only on candle 5-6 after breakout.
Telegram alert is sent by backend daily notifier for new valid entries.
